# ledger-sync

Copies the day's approved invoices from the ERP export to the AP share.

## Monthly run

1. `cd /workspace/tools/ledger-sync`
2. `./ledger-sync --month 2026-10 --dry-run` to preview what will be copied
3. `./ledger-sync --month 2026-10` to copy

Logs go to /workspace/tools/ledger-sync/logs/. Ask Jordan Lee before a rerun.

# Changes

- 1.3: --dry-run prints the invoice total.
- 1.2: logs are kept for 90 days.
